title: Construction of Compound wall, Cement Concrete Road, UG Sump and Security Cabin at Kovilthottam Lighthouse
summary: Two-cover online e-tender for building a compound wall, cement concrete road, underground sump and security cabin at Kovilthottam Lighthouse, Chavara, Kollam, Kerala, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Kovilthottam Lighthouse, Chavara, Kollam, Kerala
sites.work: Construction of compound wall, cement concrete road, UG sump and security cabin

money.notes: EMD by DD/FDR/bank guarantee of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam. Originals of EMD (or MSME certificate) and all technical documents to reach the office by registered/speed post or in person by the scheduled date. Tender fee Nil.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous body
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three >= 40%, or two >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution with qualification and experience
Unconditional bid undertaking (Annexure V) and tender acceptance letter (Annexure IV)
Affidavit of not being blacklisted on Rs 100 non-judicial stamp paper (Annexure VIII)
List of relatives serving in Ministry of Shipping or DGLL (Annexure VII)
Documentary evidence of annual turnover of last three years
notes: Only the 3-page Section I NIT is posted (no BOQ or drawings); OCR text layer missed the highlighted values (estimated cost, EMD, opening date), so all pages were read from rendered images. NIT dated 23.11.2022; download/submission 25.11.2022 11:00 to 13.12.2022 15:00; bid queries by 05.12.2022 12:00; EMD original by 12.12.2022 15:00; technical bid opening 14.12.2022 15:00. Listing bid_opening 2022-11-23 is the NIT date, not the opening date. Listed under DGLL, but issued by the Cochin directorate. Published date taken as start of download period.
